name: Rinchen Cafeteria
why_it_matters: Run by the Indian Army at 5,359m on the pass top, named after Col. Chewang Rinchen, the Ladakhi soldier decorated for the 1948 and 1971 Nubra-sector campaigns. Holds an Asia Records / Worldkings citation as the world's highest-altitude cafeteria; the photo-stop most travellers remember from the Nubra crossing.
insider_tip: Stay 10-15 minutes max — eat the Maggi, drink the tea, get back in the car. Lingering above 5,300m brings on AMS for travellers who haven't acclimatised in Leh first. Cash only; no signal for UPI.
signature_address: Khardung La Pass Top, near BRO/Army post, Leh-Nubra Road, Ladakh 194401
